Eli Turner: Heads-up: nightly billing job produced ~62 duplicate credit memos for refunds. Stripe shows single refund ids; NetSuite has two CMs for many.
Rina Shah: Only NetSuite duplicates? any pattern on time/window?
Eli Turner: yes, all created between 02:10-02:25 UTC. Example: Stripe refund rf_7cG5 -> NS CM-4401 + CM-4402.
Marco (eng): deploy today?
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/2026-04-05-01:58 by @Marco
Marco (eng): we shipped an edge rewrite to normalize Accept and some vendor headers. Looks like the HMAC header got trimmed on some requests.
Rina Shah: if signature header is missing verification fails and webhook goes to replay path. Does replay use the same idempotency key?
Marco (eng): no — replay used the raw payload + headers as key. If header mutated, key differs and replay reprocesses.
Eli Turner: logs: 
```
WARN billing:webhook - signature missing for evt_7cG5
INFO billing:replay - enqueued evt_7cG5 attempt=1
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit memo CM-4401 for refund rf_7cG5
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit memo CM-4402 for refund rf_7cG5 (replayed)
```
Marco (eng): proposed fixes: 1) make signature lookup tolerant (case + whitespace), 2) idempotency keys = stable fields (stripe_event_id + refund_id), 3) revert header normalization for /webhooks.
Rina Shah: remediation: auto-void duplicates where same external_ref and amount and created within 15m. ~62 customers affected. Need finance approval to auto-void.
sync-bot: Ticket FIN-7890 created: "Edge header rewrite -> webhook replay duplicates" assigned to Marco, priority P1.
Marco (eng): I'll push hotfix to edge and PR for idempotency change with tests.
Rina Shah: Approved for automated voids up to 100 accounts once hotfix rolled. Please post backfill results to #finance-updates.
Eli Turner: scheduling dry-run and then run at 1735004800. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
